ranking_definitions.observability: Lexicographic preference: fewer hard observability risks, fewer snapshot risks, transition, independent I/V, executable candidate, auto-assert route, evidence, candidate score, claim_id.
ranking_definitions.observability_diverse: observability order with first occurrence of each impact_id promoted ahead of repeated impact variants.
ranking_definitions.paper_proxy: PropertyGPT-style coefficients applied to deterministic token overlap: Xraw=Xsummary=scope-vs-report-impact; Yraw=Ysummary=candidate-text-vs-report-impact. This is not a reproduction of the paper (no reference property set and no LLM summaries).

policy: No frozen sample, label, denominator, execution gate, metric eligibility rule, or authoritative metric file is modified. Unknown claims remain unknown and are never counted as success.
